rice.fertilizer_guidance: Urea (N-rich) split in 3 doses + DAP at sowing
rice.irrigation_guidance: Very high water need — frequent irrigation (every 1-3 days) or naturally high-rainfall zone; watch for waterlogging.

maize.fertilizer_guidance: NPK 120:60:40 kg/ha, top-dress N at knee-high stage
maize.irrigation_guidance: Moderate water need — irrigate every 6-9 days depending on soil moisture.

chickpea.fertilizer_guidance: Low N (legume fixes its own), phosphorus-rich basal dose
chickpea.irrigation_guidance: Moderate water need — irrigate every 6-9 days depending on soil moisture.

kidneybeans.fertilizer_guidance: Light N starter dose + phosphorus for root/nodule growth
kidneybeans.irrigation_guidance: Moderate water need — irrigate every 6-9 days depending on soil moisture.

pigeonpeas.irrigation_guidance: High water need — irrigate every 3-5 days, ensure good drainage to avoid waterlogging.

mothbeans.fertilizer_guidance: Very low input, light phosphorus at sowing
mothbeans.irrigation_guidance: Low water need — irrigate every 10-14 days; prioritize drip/sprinkler to conserve water.

mungbean.fertilizer_guidance: Starter N (20 kg/ha) + phosphorus, avoid excess N
mungbean.irrigation_guidance: Low water need — irrigate every 10-14 days; prioritize drip/sprinkler to conserve water.

blackgram.fertilizer_guidance: Low N, phosphorus + potassium basal application
blackgram.irrigation_guidance: Moderate water need — irrigate every 6-9 days depending on soil moisture.

lentil.irrigation_guidance: Low water need — irrigate every 10-14 days; prioritize drip/sprinkler to conserve water.

pomegranate.fertilizer_guidance: Balanced NPK + micronutrients (Zn, Fe) in split doses
pomegranate.irrigation_guidance: Moderate water need — irrigate every 6-9 days depending on soil moisture.

banana.fertilizer_guidance: Heavy N-K feeder, monthly split doses through drip
banana.irrigation_guidance: Moderate water need — irrigate every 6-9 days depending on soil moisture.

mango.fertilizer_guidance: Organic manure + NPK after harvest, avoid excess N before flowering
mango.irrigation_guidance: Moderate water need — irrigate every 6-9 days depending on soil moisture.

grapes.fertilizer_guidance: Balanced NPK with potassium boost during berry development
grapes.irrigation_guidance: Moderate water need — irrigate every 6-9 days depending on soil moisture.

watermelon.fertilizer_guidance: Moderate N early, potassium-heavy during fruiting
watermelon.irrigation_guidance: Low water need — irrigate every 10-14 days; prioritize drip/sprinkler to conserve water.

muskmelon.fertilizer_guidance: Moderate NPK, potassium boost at fruit set
muskmelon.irrigation_guidance: Low water need — irrigate every 10-14 days; prioritize drip/sprinkler to conserve water.

apple.fertilizer_guidance: Balanced NPK in early spring + organic mulch
apple.irrigation_guidance: Moderate water need — irrigate every 6-9 days depending on soil moisture.

orange.fertilizer_guidance: Balanced NPK with micronutrients, split across seasons
orange.irrigation_guidance: Moderate water need — irrigate every 6-9 days depending on soil moisture.

papaya.fertilizer_guidance: Monthly light NPK doses, high organic matter
papaya.irrigation_guidance: High water need — irrigate every 3-5 days, ensure good drainage to avoid waterlogging.

coconut.fertilizer_guidance: NPK + Mg twice yearly, organic manure basal
coconut.irrigation_guidance: High water need — irrigate every 3-5 days, ensure good drainage to avoid waterlogging.

cotton.fertilizer_guidance: N-heavy, split in 3-4 doses with potassium at boll stage
cotton.irrigation_guidance: Moderate water need — irrigate every 6-9 days depending on soil moisture.

jute.fertilizer_guidance: Moderate N-P-K, top-dress N 3-4 weeks after sowing
jute.irrigation_guidance: High water need — irrigate every 3-5 days, ensure good drainage to avoid waterlogging.

coffee.irrigation_guidance: High water need — irrigate every 3-5 days, ensure good drainage to avoid waterlogging.
